title: Slay My Stats
description:
Uploads each run to [url=https://slay-my-stats.com]slay-my-stats.com[/url] when it ends, so you don't have to sign in and pick your history folder.

[h2]What it sends[/h2]
Your Steam ID, a short-lived Steam ticket that says this Steam account is playing, and each run as the game saves it, with a log of each fight. Runs you played unmodded before installing it are sent too.

[h2]Your saves[/h2]
With any mod loaded, the game keeps its saves in a separate "modded" folder. The first time, the game copies your progress there. Unsubscribe and it goes back to your normal saves.

[h2]Turning it off[/h2]
Switch it off in the game's mod list, or unsubscribe.

Source: [url=https://github.com/johnstonjesse329/slay-my-stats-mod]github.com/johnstonjesse329/slay-my-stats-mod[/url]
